paper_title: Constraints on scalar field dark matter from co-located Michelson interferometers
coupling_convention: Lambda_gamma in GeV (energy scale, inverse of d_gamma)
notes: Paper sets 95% CL constraints on scalar field DM coupling parameters Lambda_gamma (photon) and Lambda_e (electron) over mass range 1.6e-12 to 1.0e-7 eV using Fermilab Holometer co-located interferometers. Constrains both ScalarPhoton (Lambda_gamma) and ScalarElectron (Lambda_e). Numerical data only available in Fig. 2 (not machine-readable in text); no data table provided. DM density 0.4 GeV/cm^3 assumed for Basic Scalar and Dilaton/Modulus scenarios; Relaxion Halo scenario uses mass-dependent overdensity up to ~1e19. Limits quoted as Lambda energy scales, related to standard d-parameters by inversion.
